text: Sign in users via GitHub, Google, Facebook and 30+ other OAuth providers

text: Passwordless login via a magic link emailed to the user

text: Create anonymous guest sessions that can later be upgraded to full accounts
quote: Create guest sessions for visitors and convert to full accounts when they're ready.

text: Add multi-factor authentication for extra account security
quote: Implementing MFA to add extra layers of security to your app.

text: Track active users and broadcast online/typing/viewing status in realtime
quote: Track which signed-in users are active right now and broadcast online, typing, and viewing status in realtime.

text: Model structured relational data with typed columns, relationships and indexes
quote: Structured, relational data with typed columns, rows, relationships, and indexes.

text: Store vector embeddings and run similarity search for AI features
quote: Store embeddings and run similarity search to power AI features.

text: Connect directly to a dedicated native PostgreSQL database
quote: A dedicated, native PostgreSQL database you connect to directly.

text: Functions can be invoked by HTTP requests, SDK calls, server/database events, webhooks, or on a schedule

text: File storage API to upload, download, delete and list files with extra utilities
quote: It provides APIs to upload, download, delete, and list files, with many added utilities.

text: Offers an MCP server so LLMs can directly call Appwrite's API and docs

text: Full API coverage for managing projects, resources (rows/files/users), and deploying Functions
quote: This includes creating and managing projects, managing resources (rows, files, users), creating and deploying Appwrite Functions, and other operations available through Appwrite's API.

text: Self-host the entire platform on any OS that can run Docker
quote: Appwrite was designed from the ground up with self-hosting in mind. You can install and run Appwrite on any operating system that can run a Docker CLI.

text: AI-based labeling and understanding of image contents
quote: Label and understand the contents of images

text: Generate app icons, screenshots and QR codes on demand

text: Official CLI ships as an npm package and a dependency-free standalone binary
quote: The CLI is packaged both as an npm module as well as a standalone binary for your operating system, making it completely dependency free

text: Choose between managed database APIs with realtime/permissions or dedicated native database engines
quote: Choose the database that fits your use case, from managed APIs with permissions and realtime to dedicated native engines you connect to directly.

text: Full control over where your data is physically located

text: Send and schedule email, SMS and push notifications
